WITH bucket_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    orders.timespan,
    COUNT(DISTINCT orders.recordvault) as bucket_count
  FROM riskandmargin
  INNER JOIN orders ON riskandmargin.ordervault = orders.recordvault
  GROUP BY orders.timespan
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    timespan,
    bucket_count,
    CAST(bucket_count AS REAL) / SUM(bucket_count) OVER () as share
  FROM bucket_counts
),
with_avg_share AS (
  SELECT 
    timespan,
    bucket_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () as avg_share
  FROM with_shares
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    bucket_count,
    share,
    avg_share
  FROM with_avg_share
  WHERE share > avg_share
)
SELECT
  SUM(bucket_count) as total_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_excess
FROM filtered
